name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: Do a daily 30-minute manual crawl of the top 50 most-linked pages in the repo. This gives us the fastest way to hit +5% daily coverage without waiting for automation. The trade-off is manual effort, but it’s the only way to guarantee progress while we build smarter tools.

name: Scriv
text: Manual crawling locks in today’s coverage but guarantees tomorrow’s gap if the repo’s link topology shifts overnight—today’s "top 50" become tomorrow’s dead ends. Sift’s stake-based threshold solves the operational nightmare of defining "most-linked" by letting the graph itself surface the right pages, but only if we feed it the right seed set. Settle it: run a 24-hour Sift pass on the repo’s current graph; if it surfaces 50+ fresh links with higher in-degree than today’s top 50, we switch. If not, we keep the manual crawl but log every dead link to feed Sift tomorrow.
